features.title: Plan with AI
features.body: Answer a few questions, get project ideas that fit you, refine them with a mentor chat and receive a dated roadmap sized to your deadline.

features.title: Build as a team
features.body: Private groups with invite links, a weekly sprint board planned for you, team chat and a contribution record.

features.title: Learn the craft
features.body: Lessons on report writing, technical writing, presentations and Git, with 17 ready-made templates.

features.title: Practise your viva
features.body: An AI examiner asks questions about your own project and marks every spoken answer.

features.title: Share and get feedback
features.body: Post your progress, reports and questions. Learn from what other students are building.

journey.title: Find your idea
journey.body: Not sure what to build? Get project suggestions that fit your year, skills and deadline, then shape your choice in a guided mentor chat.

journey.title: Get your roadmap
journey.body: Your project becomes dated milestones with learning resources attached. Review it, accept it and download the PDF plan.

journey.title: Build it together
journey.body: Invite your team. Milestones are broken into weekly tasks and shared fairly. Finished tasks update the roadmap automatically.

journey.title: Write it up
journey.body: Follow short lessons on structure, tense and references, then complete the proposal, SRS, test plan and final report templates.

journey.title: Defend it with confidence
journey.body: Rehearse with the AI examiner. Every answer gets a score, feedback and a model answer before the real viva.

faq.title: Is ProjectMentor free?
faq.body: Yes. It is built for students, and every feature — roadmaps, groups, lessons, templates and the mock viva — is free to use.

faq.title: I do not have a project idea yet. Can it still help?
faq.body: Yes. Choose “Suggest ideas” and you will get projects that match your year, skills, time and deadline. Pick one and the mentor chat helps you shape it.

faq.title: Can my whole group use it together?
faq.body: Yes. Create a private group and share the invite link. Everyone gets the shared roadmap, the weekly sprint board, a team chat and a contribution record for the report.

faq.title: Who can see my work?
faq.body: Your roadmaps and viva results are private to you. Group boards and chats are visible only to group members. Only posts you choose to share appear in the community.

faq.title: What happens if the AI is busy?
faq.body: Every AI feature has a safe fallback. If the AI is slow, proven templates and rules are used, so you are never left waiting.

faq.title: Does it write my report for me?
faq.body: No, and that is deliberate. It teaches you how to write each part, gives you templates with guidance and shows strong examples. The words stay yours.
